_about: Public-domain James Durham (1622-1658, Glasgow) for the Word Hoard, all from 17th- and 18th-century printings (no 19th-century collected edition is on IA), raw Internet Archive OCR: Christ Crucified (72 sermons on Isaiah 53, 1792, 2 vols), The Law Unsealed (1777), A Commentarie upon the Book of the Revelation (1680), Clavis Cantici (1723). The Dying Man's Testament (1659) is pending. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 5 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
